findings.explanation: HOL4 specifies only `dest_Refv (Refv v) = v`. Lean returns the same `ARB` for every other constructor, so it proves that `dest_Refv` gives equal results on `W8array []` and `Varray []` at result type `Nat`. The HOL4 equation leaves those two results independent.
findings.repair:
private opaque dest_Refv_unspecified {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α := fun _ => ARB

def dest_Refv {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α
  | .Refv v => v
  | s => dest_Refv_unspecified s
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps

example : dest_Refv (.W8array [] : store_v Nat) = dest_Refv (.Varray [] : store_v Nat) := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4 saves no `FV_dec` equation for `Dmod`, `Dlocal` or `Denv`. Lean returns the same `ARB` set on all three constructors. For example, it proves `FV_dec (.Dmod m []) = FV_dec (.Dlocal [] [])` for every module name `m`, although the HOL4 equations allow those sets to differ.
findings.repair:
private opaque FV_dec_unspecified : dec → Set (Ident modN varN) := fun _ => ARB

def FV_dec : dec → Set (Ident modN varN)
  | .Dlet _ p e => FV (.Mat e [(p, .Lit ARB)])
  | .Dletrec _ defs => FV (.Letrec defs (.Lit ARB))
  | .Dtype _ _ => ∅
  | .Dtabbrev _ _ _ _ => ∅
  | .Dexn _ _ _ => ∅
  | d => FV_dec_unspecified d
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps

example (m : modN) : FV_dec (.Dmod m []) = FV_dec (.Dlocal [] []) := rfl
